project.name: Workforce Management Quality Project
project.description: Enterprise workforce management platform supporting scheduling, timecard compliance, premium overtime calculations, and labor audit governance.
project.objectives: ["100% accurate gross pay and premium overtime calculation", "Zero silent validation failures on timecard punch intervals", "Deterministic traceability from statutory regulations to automated test verification"]
project.business_scenarios: ["Employee records daily shift hours with mandatory meal break deduction", "Department manager reviews and approves weekly timecard submissions before payroll cut-off"]
project.functional_expectations: ["System shall require multi-factor authentication for Payroll Administrator accounts", "System shall reject punch-out timestamps that precede punch-in timestamps with HTTP 400 Bad Request"]
project.non_functional_expectations: ["Sub-second API response time for punch-in requests", "Complete tamper-evident audit logging on wage adjustments"]
project.constraints_and_assumptions: ["Workweek runs Monday 00:00:00 through Sunday 23:59:59", "Base currency fixed to USD ($)"]
project.explicit_exclusions: ["Direct automated ACH clearing house dispatch is handled by third-party banking integration"]
project.business_goal: Automate employee scheduling, real-time punch capture, overtime calculations, and statutory labor law compliance.

clauses.text: The system shall maintain employee identity records including unique employee identifier, job classification, home department, and base hourly rate.
The system must enforce mandatory email format validation and government identification checksum verification upon onboarding.
The system shall allow authorized employees to submit daily work shift records containing punch-in, punch-out, and unpaid meal break intervals.
The system must provide intuitive and seamless shift scheduling for department managers.
The system must reject punch records where the recorded end time precedes the recorded start time with HTTP 400 Bad Request.
All hours worked beyond 40 hours within a single standard workweek shall be paid at an overtime rate of 1.5x regular pay.
The system shall calculate overtime premiums at weekly payroll cut-off time on Sunday 23:59:59.
The system shall prevent submission of leave requests that exceed the employee's current accrued balance.
The platform shall enforce role-based access control separating Employee, Manager, and Payroll Administrator roles.
The platform must reject unauthenticated requests with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
The API Gateway shall require valid JWT Bearer tokens on all protected endpoints under `/api/v1/*`.
The system shall reject invalid or forged authentication tokens with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
The system shall invalidate inactive web sessions after an idle session timeout of 15 minutes of user inactivity.
The system must enforce role boundaries prohibiting employees from approving their own timecards with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
The payroll engine shall calculate weekly gross wages by multiplying regular hours by base hourly rate and overtime hours by the approved overtime multiplier.
The system must reject base hourly wage rates below $15.00 or exceeding $300.00 per hour with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity.
The system shall record an immutable audit log entry for every manual wage rate adjustment performed by an administrator.
The time clock interface will support biometric fingerprint scanner hardware devices for physical kiosk clock-in and employee identity verification.
The kiosk sub-system shall maintain offline punch caching when local network connectivity to the central cloud API is unavailable.
Time punch timestamps shall be rounded to the nearest quarter hour using the standard 7-minute rounding threshold.
The payroll calculation process should execute fast and efficiently without delay as needed.
All overtime hours shall be paid at a multiplier of 2.0x base hourly wage for weekend and statutory holiday work shifts.
The system shall prohibit negative leave balances under all standard employment agreements.
The system shall enforce role boundaries for 'Employee'.
Description: Standard workforce member.
Allowed Permissions: timecard.submit, timecard.view_self, leave.request.
Responsibilities: Record shift hours and submit absence requests.
Restrictions: Cannot view peer records or approve timecards.
The system shall enforce role boundaries for 'Department Manager'.
Description: Operational supervisor.
Allowed Permissions: timecard.approve, timecard.view_team, leave.approve.
Responsibilities: Review shift logs, approve overtime, and supervise schedules.
Restrictions: Cannot alter payroll wage configuration.
The system shall enforce role boundaries for 'Payroll Administrator'.
Description: Financial operations specialist.
Allowed Permissions: payroll.calculate, payroll.export, wage.adjust, audit.view.
Responsibilities: Execute gross-to-net payroll runs and process wage adjustments.
Restrictions: Must provide dual-authorization for manual overrides.
The system shall enforce role boundaries for 'Compliance Auditor'.
Description: Statutory auditor.
Allowed Permissions: audit.view, report.generate, compliance.inspect.
Responsibilities: Review historical labor logs and audit trails.
Restrictions: Read-only access to all operational data.
Overtime calculation threshold: 40 hours per calendar workweek
Mandatory meal break: minimum 30 minutes for shifts over 6 hours
Quarter-hour punch rounding threshold: standard 7-minute window
All API endpoints require cryptographically verified JWT Bearer tokens; session inactivity timeout of 15 minutes.
The product must maintain demonstrable adherence to FLSA 29 U.S.C. § 207 regulatory and security guidelines.
The product must maintain demonstrable adherence to California Labor Code § 510 regulatory and security guidelines.
The product must maintain demonstrable adherence to SOC 2 Type II regulatory and security guidelines.
Employee records daily shift hours with mandatory meal break deduction
Department manager reviews and approves weekly timecard submissions before payroll cut-off
System shall require multi-factor authentication for Payroll Administrator accounts
System shall reject punch-out timestamps that precede punch-in timestamps with HTTP 400 Bad Request
The system must reject expired or malformed authentication tokens with HTTP 401 Unauthorized and prevent unauthorized access to protected endpoints.

Allowed Permissions: payroll.calculate, payroll.export, wage.adjust, audit.view. Responsibilities: Execute gross-to-net payroll runs and process wage adjustments. Restrictions: Must provide dual-authorization for manual overrides.
requirement_versions.business_objective: Role Authorization Specification for Payroll Administrator

requirement_versions.title: Role Access Control: Compliance Auditor
requirement_versions.description: The system shall enforce role boundaries for 'Compliance Auditor'. Description: Statutory auditor. Allowed Permissions: audit.view, report.generate, compliance.inspect. Responsibilities: Review historical labor logs and audit trails. Restrictions: Read-only access to all operational data.
requirement_versions.business_objective: Role Authorization Specification for Compliance Auditor

# Workforce Management Quality Platform — Product Requirements Document (PRD)

## 1. Executive Summary & Vision
The Workforce Management Quality Platform (WFMQ) is an enterprise SaaS platform engineered to unify employee scheduling, labor compliance, shift tracking, and statutory gross pay calculations across distributed hourly and salaried operations.

## 2. Core Functional Modules
### 2.1 Employee Master Data Management (EMP)
- The system shall maintain employee identity records including unique employee identifier, job classification, home department, and base hourly rate.
- The system must enforce mandatory email format validation and government identification checksum verification upon onboarding.

### 2.2 Time & Attendance Tracking (ATT)
- The system shall allow authorized employees to submit daily work shift records containing punch-in, punch-out, and unpaid meal break intervals.
- The system must provide intuitive and seamless shift scheduling for department managers.
- The system must reject punch records where the recorded end time precedes the recorded start time with HTTP 400 Bad Request.

### 2.3 Overtime Calculation Policy (PAY-OT)
- All hours worked beyond 40 hours within a single standard workweek shall be paid at an overtime rate of 1.5x regular pay.
- The system shall calculate overtime premiums at weekly payroll cut-off time on Sunday 23:59:59.

### 2.4 Annual Leave & Time-Off Accrual (LVE)
- New employees become eligible for annual paid leave after a probation period of 90 days from the hire date.
- The system shall prevent submission of leave requests that exceed the employee's current accrued balance.

## 3. Security & Operational Boundaries
- The platform shall enforce role-based access control separating Employee, Manager, and Payroll Administrator roles.
- The platform must reject unauthenticated requests with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

# Workforce Management Quality Platform — Software Requirements Specification (SRS)

## 1. System Scope & Interface Requirements
This specification defines the functional software requirements, API interface contracts, and input boundary criteria for the WFMQ platform service endpoints.

## 2. Authentication & Authorization Interfaces (SRS-SEC)
- The API Gateway shall require valid JWT Bearer tokens on all protected endpoints under `/api/v1/*`.
- The system shall reject invalid or forged authentication tokens with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
- The system shall invalidate inactive web sessions after an idle session timeout of 15 minutes of user inactivity.
- The system must enforce role boundaries prohibiting employees from approving their own timecards with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

## 3. Timecard & Payroll Processing Engine (SRS-PAY)
- The payroll engine shall calculate weekly gross wages by multiplying regular hours by base hourly rate and overtime hours by the approved overtime multiplier.
- The system must reject base hourly wage rates below $15.00 or exceeding $300.00 per hour with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity.
- The system shall record an immutable audit log entry for every manual wage rate adjustment performed by an administrator.

## 4. Hardware Kiosk & Biometric Interfaces (SRS-HW)
- The time clock interface will support biometric fingerprint scanner hardware devices for physical kiosk clock-in and employee identity verification.
- The kiosk sub-system shall maintain offline punch caching when local network connectivity to the central cloud API is unavailable.

# Workforce Management Quality Platform — Statutory Business Rules & Payroll Policy

## 1. Statutory Time Tracking & Rounding Rules (BR-ATT)
- Time punch timestamps shall be rounded to the nearest quarter hour using the standard 7-minute rounding threshold.
- Shifts exceeding 6 consecutive hours require a minimum mandatory unpaid meal deduction of 30 minutes.
- The payroll calculation process should execute fast and efficiently without delay as needed.

## 2. Premium Overtime Compensation Rules (BR-PAY-CONTRADICTION)
- All overtime hours shall be paid at a multiplier of 2.0x base hourly wage for weekend and statutory holiday work shifts.
- Any manual override of calculated overtime premiums requires dual-authorization from both Finance and Operations department heads.

## 3. Paid Time Off & Absence Governance (BR-LVE-CONTRADICTION)
- Employees become eligible for annual paid leave after a probation period of 30 days under collective bargaining agreements.
- Unused annual leave balances up to a maximum of 40 hours may be carried forward into the subsequent calendar year.
- The system shall prohibit negative leave balances under all standard employment agreements.

project_contexts.product_overview: Unified workforce management system managing labor scheduling, timecard approvals, statutory meal breaks, and overtime calculations.
project_contexts.problem_statement: Manual timesheet processes introduce compliance risks, meal break violations, and payroll calculation errors.
project_contexts.architecture_context: Cloud-native microservices backend with asynchronous payroll calculation engine and deterministic simulation models.

project_contexts.business_rules: ["Overtime calculation threshold: 40 hours per calendar workweek", "Mandatory meal break: minimum 30 minutes for shifts over 6 hours", "Quarter-hour punch rounding threshold: standard 7-minute window"]
project_contexts.security_expectations: All API endpoints require cryptographically verified JWT Bearer tokens; session inactivity timeout of 15 minutes.
project_contexts.privacy_requirements: Employee PII and wage details encrypted at rest using AES-256.
project_contexts.performance_expectations: Clock-in endpoint latency p95 < 250ms under peak shift transitions.
project_contexts.availability_expectations: 99.95% system uptime during operational workweek hours.
project_contexts.assumptions: ["Employees clock in via authenticated web browser or biometric terminal."]
project_contexts.exclusions: ["Automated tax withholding calculations deferred to external payroll provider."]
